form.label: Remediation
form.description: What has actually been fixed, and what merely stopped being reported.

search.query: `riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | where status="open" | stats dc(finding_key) AS n
`riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | where status="mitigated" | stats dc(finding_key) AS n

single.option: package upgraded at the same path

search.query: `riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | where status="removed" | stats dc(finding_key) AS n

single.option: package no longer at that path

search.query: `riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | where status="unknown" | stats dc(finding_key) AS n

panel.title: Mitigated: the upgrade that fixed it

search.query: `riskability_mitigated_findings` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | eval fixed_after_days = round((last_seen - first_seen)/86400, 1) | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | table cve_id, package, ecosystem, mitigation, root, hostname, path, fixed_after_days, epss | rename cve_id AS "CVE", package AS "Package", ecosystem AS "Type", mitigation AS "Version change", root AS "Root", hostname AS "Host", path AS "Path", fixed_after_days AS "Open for (days)", epss AS "EPSS" | sort - "EPSS"

panel.title: Closed without evidence of a fix

html.p: These findings stopped being reported, but the package is no longer at that path at all, or the host stopped reporting entirely. Neither is proof of remediation: a failed scan, a decommissioned host, or a feed imported without the relevant ecosystem all look exactly like this. They are listed separately from mitigated findings for that reason.

search.query: `riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | where status="removed" OR status="unknown" | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | table cve_id, package, last_version, status, root, hostname, path, last_seen | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename cve_id AS "CVE", package AS "Package", last_version AS "Last seen version", status AS "Status", root AS "Root", hostname AS "Host", path AS "Path", last_seen AS "Last reported"
`riskability_finding_lifecycle` | search hostname=$host_tok|s$ | eval day = strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d") | stats dc(finding_key) AS findings BY day, status | sort day
